Controller: @nestjs/common: class decorator marking a REST controller
Head: @nestjs/common: method decorator, HTTP HEAD
All: @nestjs/common: method decorator matching every HTTP method
HttpCode: @nestjs/common: method decorator setting the handler's response status
setGlobalPrefix: @nestjs/common: INestApplication method putting a path in front of every route
NestFactory: @nestjs/core: the class whose create() makes the application
create: @nestjs/core: NestFactory's static method that makes the application
exclude: @nestjs/common: GlobalPrefixOptions key listing the routes the prefix leaves out
path: @nestjs/common: RouteInfo key for an excluded route's path
method: @nestjs/common: RouteInfo key for an excluded route's RequestMethod
version: @nestjs/common: ControllerOptions key for the versions a controller serves
Version: @nestjs/common: method decorator setting the versions one route serves
VERSION_NEUTRAL: @nestjs/common: the version value that serves every version
enableVersioning: @nestjs/common: INestApplication method that turns API versioning on
prefix: @nestjs/common: UriVersioningOptions key for the text before a version in the path
v: @nestjs/common: the default text before a version in the path
defaultVersion: @nestjs/common: VersioningOptions key for the version a route that states none serves
Body: @nestjs/common: parameter decorator injecting the request body
Param: @nestjs/common: parameter decorator injecting a path parameter
Query: @nestjs/common: parameter decorator injecting a query parameter
Req: @nestjs/common: parameter decorator injecting the request object
Request: @nestjs/common: parameter decorator injecting the request object
Res: @nestjs/common: parameter decorator injecting the response object
Response: @nestjs/common: parameter decorator injecting the response object
Next: @nestjs/common: parameter decorator injecting the next function
Ip: @nestjs/common: parameter decorator injecting the client IP
HostParam: @nestjs/common: parameter decorator injecting a host parameter
